We have earned their trust. Our definitions of customers satisfactions going for beyond providing reliable products at competitive prices. It includes customers expectations with courteous knowledgeable order taking on-time delivery and fast response to every customer inquiry.
PERFORMANCE CERTIFICATE

QUALITY ASSURANCE
We ensure to deliver high quality & timely delivery of products. PM industries are committed to producing high-quality heat shrinkable power cable accessories to meet or exceed the highest performance standards in many countries. A well established Q.A. system corporate as various levels of design development and manufacturing ensures for repeatable results which ensure for an excellent performance of our products in actual conditions.
Our Product
Heat shrinkable terminations and straight through joints offer technical superiority for perfect terminations and joints for PVS/PILC/XLPE/EPR low  and medium range power cable up to 33 KVA cables.
Utilizing state of the art polymer manufacturing technology "PM-Seal" brand power cable 
       accessories provide excellent protection against tracking electrical stress & dielectric stress.
"PM-Seal" branded kits exhibit the ability to effective functions under the most strengthen operating conditions for most at least the life of the cable on worldwide. "PM-Seal" branded kits are technically, environmentally and user-friendly.

The termination & joint kits are heat shrinkable designed for extruded, armored and unarmored cables. The installed terminations virtually duplicate a cable systems performance electrically thermally and mechanically. The design is flexible to accommodate out of round or off tolerance cable in both round & sector shaped conductors.

Polymer Insulator
Home
POLYMER INSULATOR
INTRUDUCTION
The high-performance Composite Polymeric Silicone insulators play an indispensable role here. The silicone rubber insulation for composite silicone-based housing demonstrates excellent pollution layer characteristics. Compote polymeric silicone insulators with silicone rubber possess unique properties. Silicone rubber Is the fastest growing& most dominant polymeric insulation material for high voltage product.
Composite Polymeric Silicone Insulators are available for applications up to system voltage of 33 kV and provide a reliable solution for power utilities& Railways globally. All PM   insulators are manufactured at high pressure and high temperature by direct injection molding machines.
Composite Polymeric Silicone Insulators consist of silicone housing over fiberglass rod to which galvanized steel or aluminum end fining are attached. The core of the insulator is of fiberglass rod which provides high mechanical strength. A metal end fitting is crimped onto each end of the rod to provide high mechanical strength.
Composite Polymeric Silicone Insulators are made with the most advanced materials (silicone-based) resulting from field experience gained for more than 30 years.
The perfect interface between rod and silicone housing will not allow any development of internal tracking under the silicone housing.
STANDARDS
PM make Composite Polymeric Silicon Insulators have been designed,developed and manufactured in compliance to International Standard IEC 61109
PERFORMANCE
During Transportation and Installation
Light-weight and easy installation
Resistance to damage arising from transport
During Operation
Better electrical performance and reliability
Excellent anti-tracking properties
High mechanical strength FRP
Excellent performance under polluted environment
Silicon housing has excellent hydrophobic properties
Throughout the entire life
Long service life
Maintenance-free
Free from moisture ingress
DESIGNS
lnner core (FRP)
The inner core of the insulator is made of high-quality fiberglass that has been specially formulated for electrical and mechanical applications.
Silicone Housing
The housing and sheds are one piece. injection-molded silicone rubber is chemically bonded to the inner core. The silicone compound provides excellent hydrophobic and recovery characteristics which limits leakage current.
End fitting
The end fitting is made of high strength forged steel having high mechanical strength. The steel end fittings are hot-dip galvanized.
